notes: Tiny file: 2 thumb functions (~0x60 and ~0x26 bytes) + one 0x2c-byte rodata template. Setup/teardown wrapper around a display-capture (REG_DISPCAPCNT) SysTask system implemented in asm/overlay_01_021F4464.s. ov01_021F467C allocates a one-pointer handle on heap 4 (HEAP_ID_FIELD1), disables BG1/BG2/BG3 planes, resets BG VRAM banks, builds the config from the rodata template with EVA/EVB params, and starts the capture task; ov01_021F46DC restores graphics mode (1,0,1), re-banks VRAM C for BG, re-enables planes 0xE, and frees the handle. Only caller is event_cutscene_celebi.c (overlay_02) plus a reference in asm/overlay_116.s. Pool literals: one '.word ov01_02206B94' per function; '.balign 4,0' after each.
